quarterly_data.quarter: IonQ press release: IonQ and SDT Announce the First Strategic Partnership to (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IonQ announced a multi-year strategic partnership with Korea-based SDT, Inc.: IonQ will supply SDT with a Superion 256 quantum computer and IonQ's silicon-vacancy (SiV) quantum memory module - the first Superion 256 system and first SiV memory module for South Korea - planned for deployment with an SDT customer in South Korea, where the companies intend to collaborate on a hybrid quantum-classical data center. The partnership extends from cloud software integration to hardware production, assembly and regional resale; SDT plans a quantum manufacturing and system-integration facility in Gumi, South Korea, to host IonQ's SiV quantum memory packaging and manufacturing and quantum system assembly, integration and commissioning. CEO Niccolo de Masi: demand for the new Superion 256 system is growing globally.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 Superion 256 system plus SiV quantum memory module
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer and regional resale / assembly partner (Korea)
